title: PR-001 look check: record the iPhone screen while 4 versions play (about 6 min)
instructions: The phone records its own screen; the Mac camera is not used. Numbers only: no agent looks at the video without asking you first.

parts.label: Start the screen recording
parts.instructions: On the iPhone: turn on Do Not Disturb. Open Control Center, press and hold the Screen Recording button and check that Microphone is OFF. Tap Start Recording, wait for the 3-second countdown, then close Control Center. Click Done here when it is recording ("started").

parts.label: Versions 1-4 play (about 3.5 min)
parts.instructions: Click Start, then put the phone down and don't touch it. I load 4 versions of the page, one after another, about 48 s each. I finish this part myself when version 4 is done.

parts.label: Stop the recording
parts.instructions: Tap the red recording indicator at the top of the iPhone screen, then Stop. Click Done.

parts.label: Move the file to the Mac
parts.instructions: AirDrop the recording from Photos to this Mac. Then drag it from Downloads into this folder: /Users/<user>/source/fastwork-com-web-optimize/.claude/worktrees/agent-afc7d9fff1fcc6154/out/pr001-visual/ . Click Done when it is moved ("moved"). The copy in your Photos is yours to delete.
